observations.observed_result: CHK-07-004 DONG DUT DIEM cau hoi P1 con lai (server co thuc su chan hay chi la UI tu an nut xoa): tao product test moi (id 3244), lien ket voi campaign 2595 qua GraphQL insert (campaign_products id=4060), xac nhan deletion-check tra {policy:'blocked', reason:'IN_CAMPAIGNS'} dung nhu ky vong. Goi THANG DELETE /api/products/3244 (khong qua bat ky UI nao) — LAN DAU vo tinh gui thua header Content-Type tren request khong co body, nhan 405 'Method Not Allowed' dang trang loi HTML generic tang ha tang (header Allow:'PUT, DELETE') — DA NHAN RA day la loi request cua chinh minh (khac voi cach goi DELETE da chung minh hoat dong o cac ACT khac), KHONG phai bang chung ve app. Goi LAI voi header dung chuan (bo Content-Type thua, chi Authorization + Accept:application/json) -> nhan HTTP 403 Forbidden RO RANG voi body JSON {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"}. Xac nhan qua GraphQL: product 3244 VAN TON TAI sau ca 2 lan goi DELETE (khong bi xoa). KET LUAN DUT DIEM: server THUC SU CHAN o TANG UNG DUNG (tra 403 + message ro rang), HOAN TOAN KHONG PHAI chi la UI/client tu an nut xoa — cau hoi P1 goc cua KB v1 (KB-058/059) nay da co bang chung TRUC TIEP, doc lap voi UI. Chu y phu: message loi nhac toi 'invalid confirmation token', lien he voi field 'token' trong deletion-check luon null (CHK-07-009) - co the la 1 co che xac nhan token chua duoc kich hoat, GHI NHAN nhu mot manh moi, KHONG suy dien them vi chi quan sat duoc trong pham vi hep nay.
